preconditions.name: reached_p2_alive
preconditions.description: P1 survival >= 2/3 seeds so the agent reaches P2 alive (same precondition shape 603n/812 already validated on this exact curriculum).
preconditions.control: P1 survival gate (median episode length last window >= scaffold_p1_survival_gate_steps).

preconditions.name: baseline_no_op_opportunity
preconditions.description: ARM_0 P2 action_density stays below the saturation ceiling on a majority of seeds -- the exact headroom condition that starved 3/5 seeds in V3-EXQ-624c.
preconditions.control: measured directly from ARM_0's own P2 pass (vigor bias forced to zero via w_action=w_passive=0.0).

preconditions.name: arm0_bias_channel_silenced
preconditions.description: ARM_0's tonic-vigor bias_max_abs reads exactly 0.0 on every seed that reached P2 -- confirms the w_action=w_passive=0.0 toggle actually zeroed the channel (the V3-EXQ-643 lesson, applied to the reference arm).
preconditions.control: TonicVigor.get_state()['last_bias_max_abs'], accumulated over every P2 tick in ARM_0.

c2_informative_form_discrimination.note: EXPLORATORY / NOT GATING -- n<=3 seeds cannot power a real regression against a pre-existing-action-preference axis. Reported as raw per-seed lifts only; a genuine additive-vs-multiplicative discrimination needs the parametric sweep the original MECH-320 registration (claims.yaml, R3) describes and this run does not attempt.
